title_en: He Shengchang v. People's Insurance Company of China, Shenze County Branch — dispute over property insurance contract

full_text_en:
He Shengchang v. People's Insurance Company of China, Shenze County Sub-branch

— dispute over property insurance contract

Plaintiff: He Shengchang, male, 33 years old, a native of Shenze County, Hebei Province, a cadre of Xihe Township of said county.

Defendant: People's Insurance Company of China, Shenze County Sub-branch (formerly the Agency Office of People's Insurance Company of China, Shenze County, hereinafter referred to as Shenze County Sub-branch).

In 1984, the defendant Shenze County Sub-branch launched the summer grain fire insurance business for threshing grounds for the first time. On June 3 of the same year, the plaintiff He Shengchang and Shenze County Sub-branch entered into a summer grain fire insurance contract for threshing grounds regarding He Shengchang's insured 7.38 mu of wheat, based on an predicted insured yield of 560 jin per mu, priced at RMB 0.20 per jin, totaling an insured wheat volume of 4,133 jin and an insurance amount of RMB 826.60. The contract provided that the insurer, Shenze County Sub-branch, would provide fire insurance for the wheat on the insured He Shengchang's threshing ground from the time the wheat was brought into the threshing ground on June 10, 1984, to July 9 of the same year. During this period, if a fire occurred on the threshing ground causing loss to the insured wheat, the insurer would be liable for compensation. However, the insurer would not be liable for compensation for loss of the insured wheat caused by fire in three situations: (1) fire caused by the intentional act of the insured or his family members; (2) natural disasters and accidents other than fire; (3) fire caused by the insured threshing wheat on a public road in violation of traffic department regulations. Meanwhile, the contract stipulated the obligations of the insured: to pay the insurance premium in a lump sum at the rate of 1‰ of the insurance amount before the inception date; to comply with the regulations of the public security fire department and relevant authorities, to accept the insurer's suggestions on safety conditions, and to do a good job of fire prevention and safety; in the event of a fire on the threshing ground, to actively rescue and minimize losses, to protect the scene after the accident, to promptly report to the relevant authorities and notify the insurer within two days.

On the day the contract was signed, He Shengchang paid the insurance premium of RMB 0.83 in a lump sum to Shenze County Sub-branch, and the contract took effect. A few days later, He Shengchang harvested the wheat and brought it into the threshing ground. On June 16, He Shengchang went to his post at the township office and asked his younger brother He Huichang to watch over the threshing ground. He Huichang went home for dinner, and after dinner went out on business, leaving the threshing ground unattended. At about 10:00 p.m., a fire broke out on the threshing ground. The crowd worked to extinguish it, but because there was no water source around the threshing ground, of the three stacks of insured wheat, except for one stack of seed wheat, the other two stacks were almost completely burned, leaving only 430 jin of wheat. The next day, He Shengchang notified Shenze County Sub-branch of the fire. Shenze County Sub-branch, together with the Fire Prevention Section of the County Public Security Bureau and relevant units, conducted an inspection of the fire scene. The conclusion of the Fire Prevention Section of the County Public Security Bureau was: the cause of the fire was unknown. Afterwards, since Shenze County Sub-branch could not provide any basis for the exclusions stipulated in the contract, He Shengchang demanded that Shenze County Sub-branch compensate for the fire loss in full, based on the insurance amount stipulated in the insurance contract, deducting the value of the remaining 430 jin of wheat. Shenze County Sub-branch, on the grounds that He Shengchang's actual wheat yield was lower than the predicted yield at the time of insurance, and that the fire loss was not that great, refused to calculate compensation based on the insurance amount, insisting on compensating only for the loss based on the actual yield. The parties disputed, and on September 3, 1984, He Shengchang filed a lawsuit with the Shenze County People's Court of Hebei Province.

The Shenze County People's Court accepted the case according to law. After mediation, the parties failed to reach an agreement. Therefore, with reference to the provisions of Article 46 of the Economic Contract Law of the People's Republic of China, on November 24, 1984, the court rendered a judgment: The fire loss amount was calculated as the insurance amount of RMB 826.60 stipulated in the insurance contract minus the value of the remaining 430 jin of wheat, RMB 86, leaving RMB 740.60, of which the defendant Shenze County Sub-branch was to bear 80% compensation, totaling RMB 592.48; the plaintiff He Shengchang was to bear 20%, totaling RMB 148.12. After the judgment was announced, both He Shengchang and Shenze County Sub-branch refused to accept it, and successively appealed to the Shijiazhuang Intermediate People's Court of Hebei Province on the same grounds as the original complaint.

Upon trial of the second instance, the Shijiazhuang Intermediate People's Court held that: (1) The summer grain fire insurance contract for threshing grounds signed between He Shengchang and Shenze County Sub-branch was legal and valid, and both parties should earnestly perform it. Since the fire occurred within the insurance period, and Shenze County Sub-branch could not prove any exclusion of liability for the fire, the insurer, Shenze County Sub-branch, should be liable for compensation for the fire loss. (2) The contract insurance amount was determined before the wheat was brought into the threshing ground, based on the predicted insured per-mu yield, and Shenze County Sub-branch also collected the insurance premium based on that insurance amount. Since the prediction of the insured per-mu yield was only an estimate, it was impossible for it to be exactly consistent with the actual yield; moreover, in subsequent multiple investigations, neighboring farmers around He Shengchang's wheat field, although their estimates of the per-mu yield of He Shengchang's wheat field for that year varied, were generally close to the predicted yield at the time of insurance. At the same time, under the circumstances where the wheat on the threshing ground had been burned to ashes, it was impossible to accurately determine the actual quantity of the burned wheat. Therefore, Shenze County Sub-branch's argument that He Shengchang's actual wheat yield was lower than the predicted yield at the time of insurance, and its claim for compensation based on the loss of actual yield, lacked sufficient grounds and reliable evidence, and was not accepted. The amount of compensation should be calculated based on the insurance amount stipulated in the contract. (3) Before the fire, although He Shengchang had placed a fireproof water vat on the threshing ground, he had not filled it with water, so that after the fire started, the crowd used sand and stones to extinguish it, failing to effectively reduce the loss. Furthermore, at the time of the fire, He Shengchang's younger brother He Huichang went home for dinner and did not return to watch the threshing ground after the meal, resulting in the flames not being discovered in time and escalating into a major fire. Therefore, He Shengchang should also bear some responsibility for the fire loss. Based on this, the Shijiazhuang Intermediate People's Court held that the first-instance judgment of the Shenze County People's Court in this case had clear findings of fact and correct application of law; it was not inappropriate to calculate compensation based on the insurance amount, deduct the value of the remaining 430 jin of wheat, and have Shenze County Sub-branch compensate 80% of the remaining portion, with He Shengchang bearing 20% himself. Pursuant to Article 151(1) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China (for Trial Implementation), on March 30, 1985, the court rendered a judgment dismissing the appeals of He Shengchang and Shenze County Sub-branch and affirming the original judgment.

At its 226th meeting on June 5, 1985, the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court, pursuant to the provisions of Article 11(1) of the Organic Law of the People's Courts of the People's Republic of China, in summarizing trial experience, considered that the widespread implementation of the property insurance system is an aspect of China's economic system reform, and plays a positive role in stabilizing the socialist economic order, promoting production, and stabilizing the people's livelihood. In trial work, the people's courts should actively provide legal protection for the correct implementation of property insurance contracts. The first-instance judgment of the Shenze County People's Court of Hebei Province and the second-instance judgment of the Shijiazhuang Intermediate People's Court in this case distinguished right from wrong, clarified responsibility, and handled the matter properly. They not only protected the legitimate rights and interests of the insured but also safeguarded the legitimate interests of the insurer, and may serve as a reference for people's courts at all levels.
